about:
Alternative Wire & Cable operates from Blue Springs, Missouri, serving as a distributor of electrical wiring and motor repair products. The company supplies copper wire, magnet wire, wire and cable, electrical insulation, motors, motor parts, shop equipment, and test equipment to its customers.

Its product range extends to mica products, adhesives and sealants, pressure sensitive tape, flexible insulation, lacing and banding, rigid insulation, and terminals and connectors. The business focuses on providing these materials to electrical original equipment manufacturers and motor repair shops across the Midwestern United States.

The company states its mission is to be the premier service and solutions provider for electrical insulation materials used in apparatus repair and electrical OEM sites throughout the Midwest. This focus on a specific regional market and product niche shapes its customer relationships and inventory decisions.
